Write a small Kotlin app that outputs "Hello, World!" on the console.

First, the app has to print exactly: "Hello, World!"
Then, the output we expect is:
  "Hello, World!"
Also, set up a GitHub Actions workflow building the project on every push to main
Also, give the workflow file a meaningful name such as test-hello-world.yml
Also, include clear comments and Kotlin best practices
Finally, an optional CI badge
